integration_scope: Readable workbench results with complete expandable details; correct running release in component inventory; manual update groups separated from actual errors and candidates; optional legacy archive inventory only when present. Voice implementation, models, authentication and portable runtime remain unchanged.
source_commit_resolution: Build receipt binds final commit and all payload files; this source metadata does not assert approval, signature or activation.
exclusion_reason: Unchanged host-specific legacy scripts remain only in trusted signed baseline runtime.
acceptance_limits: Firecrawl is an external service. Limited keyless access is the default; an optional host-configured API key may consume its plan.
Web search returns source links and snippets; no automatic crawling, browser operation, social sign-in or page rendering.
Document converters are bundled for the existing portable Windows x64 Python 3.12 runtime. No local document upload to cloud services.
PDF text and modern DOCX/PPTX/XLSX only, plus retained TXT/Markdown/CSV. No OCR, old binary Office formats or macro execution.
Owner authority, versioned history and personal memory are preserved. Moving the installed package to another computer is not physically tested in this update.

Voice uses the Windows default microphone and local English Whisper transcription. Silero v6.2.0 classifies speech locally in 32 ms frames; three speech votes within 160 ms confirm speech, and 1.6 seconds without confirmed speech ends the turn. No semantic turn prediction, playback barge-in or exact ChatGPT parity. No new recording or idle timer; bounded 0.8-second pre-roll, manual Stop/End, cancellation, hidden-tab/disconnection cleanup, the existing 100 MiB utterance boundary and transcription processing limit remain. Dev16 automatic pause ending, spoken 42/50 replies, return to Listening and End microphone cleanup were confirmed by the owner. This release preserves that implementation.
